name: recoil_state_cheat_code_on_deactivate
description: RecoilStateCheatCode::OnDeactivate captures the cheat-code text, tears down the dialog, unloads DIALOG sounds, restores audio/video/HUD modes, reactivates the HUD layout, and executes the captured command string.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the cheat-code dialog/state source cluster.
Exception-registration and CString cleanup shape remain tier S debt.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja HLIL and assembly for 0x407010 validate default CString construction, optional cheat input buffer assignment when m_dialog is non-null, postprocess, SetEnabled(0), BlitOwnedSurfaceToPrimary, unlock, dialog scalarDeletingDtor(1), m_dialog clear, zSndSampleSet::DestroyByName("DIALOG"), optional snapshot restore, half-res and invalidate restore from m_prevHalfResAdjustMode, HudUiMgr::TriggerCurrentLayoutOnActivated, HudCheat::ExecuteCommandString, and CString destruction.

The native smoke enters the cheat-code state through OnTryBecomeCurrent, then verifies OnDeactivate clears and deletes the dialog, restores half-res and invalidate modes, unloads the DIALOG sample set, activates the current layout, and leaves the audio snapshot available for caller-owned cleanup.
